hero.headline: Gather. Worship. Grow.
hero.subheadline: Join us for Spirit-filled services, Bible study, and special gatherings — online and in person.

services.headline: Join Us Every Week
services.subtext: All are welcome. Come as you are.

items.label: Morning Worship Service
items.description: Start your Sunday with powerful praise, prayer, and the Word of God.

items.label: Family Worship Service
items.description: Our main gathering — vibrant worship, biblical teaching, and community.

items.label: Midweek Bible Study
items.description: Go deeper into God's Word with teaching, discussion, and prayer.

watch.headline: Join Us Online
watch.body: Can't make it in person? Stream our services live and stay connected with the Illumination Global Ministries family from anywhere in the world.
watch.note: Live stream link will be shared before each service.

items.title: First Sunday Communion Service
items.description: A special service of worship, the Lord's Supper, and corporate prayer as we begin the month together.

items.title: Prayer & Fasting Day
items.description: A dedicated day of corporate prayer, intercession, and seeking God together for our community and the nations.

items.title: Missions Sunday
items.description: Celebrating and supporting our global outreach work — hear testimonies and learn how you can be part of the mission.

items.title: Christmas Candlelight Service
items.description: A beautiful evening of carols, Scripture readings, and candlelight worship to celebrate the birth of Jesus Christ.

location.headline: We'd Love to See You
location.note: Join us in person at our Fulshear location or stream any service live online from anywhere in the world.
